cases.prompt: Set up spec-driven development in this repo so the agent writes a spec before coding.
I want a constitution plus per-feature spec/plan/tasks with acceptance-criteria traceability.
This repo is empty. Interview me until the spec and the constitution are actually filled in, don't hand me a template full of placeholders.
We have a large existing codebase. Reconstruct specs from it without reading every file, and let me approve each one before you write it.
We have an old spec-registry.json from this harness lying around — help us migrate off it.
Give me a structural score for our SDD harness across constitution, planning, and verification.
Which Claude model should I use for summarization?
Just give me a simple feature list and an init script, no specs.
A freshly scaffolded harness should have no separate state file — each feature's phase lives in its own markdown.
cases.expect: create-sdd-harness.mjs writes no spec-registry.json; spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md each carry a **Phase:** line and no unfilled {{PLACEHOLDER}}

cases.prompt: During a greenfield interview the agent should ask one question per turn and never invent the next one.
cases.expect: each turn runs interview.mjs next, reads the ASK: line verbatim, and records the answer via interview.mjs answer before asking anything else

cases.prompt: The user answers 'it should just work well' to the quality-bar question.
cases.expect: interview.mjs answer exits non-zero with REJECTED and RE-ASK; the agent shows the reason to the user and asks again instead of recording it

cases.prompt: Adopting SDD on an existing repo, the agent must not read the source files itself.
cases.expect: recon.mjs produces the digest and the agent works from it; no Read of target source files, and no function body appears in any spec

cases.prompt: A reconstructed spec must not land in specs/ before the user has seen it.
cases.expect: --propose writes nothing outside .sdd/; only --write creates specs/NNN-slug/, stamped with Confirmed-by/Confirmed-on

cases.prompt: An older project still calls check-traceability.mjs from init.sh against a spec-registry.json it has on disk. Running it must not break init.sh.
cases.expect: check-traceability.mjs and validate-sdd-harness.mjs always exit 0 and print a deprecation notice, regardless of spec-registry.json content
